## LEG 4 HANDOFF (claude-sonnet-5-5; cap ~1445/1500; best score 45 (before a deliberate restore to slot 17 at 38); alive at the PX hanging from the balloon-creature leash, day 3)
### Map additions / facts this leg

- Casino dice: Roll = random total + Footnote 1 ("special zero-gee dice which project their own gravitational field onto the nearest surface. ... notoriously easy to load"). Roll at PX / Doc's / Pet Store: no visible effect. Probably flavour or for loaded-dice gambling (never found a use).

- Elevator: E from Level Five without elevator = fatal plunge; keypad 9 (and 1) = power-dive death even with all green. Lights go out in the elevator room. DO NOT USE.

### Puzzles solved
- BALLOON CREATURE / CHAPEL STAR (+7, score 45): Flophouse spray can (12 sprays total) + Pet Store creature. Spray in each room I enter (creature "farts in" one room behind; spray where I am). Cross into gravity at East Connection (creature "caught unawares by gravity"). TAKE LEASH there => lifted 2 m ("hanging in air", only exit Down = let go). In the Chapel: switch flame OFF, spray (creature arrives), take leash, OPEN star -> M-series hyperdiode, TAKE (+7). M-series diode: does not fit jammer; real use unknown (maybe detonator? collater? comm).

1. PX stuck timer/bit: bought item 9 twice and item 6 once; all "loud klunk", nothing in hole. Reach in = "feel something with fingertips, can't get a grip" even hanging 2 m from the balloon creature at the hole => height is NOT the issue. Throw boots at hole = "You missed". Shoved items (dice, detonator, boots) drop out. Ideas not yet tried: wearing the plastic bag/space suit gloves; sticky Fire Nectar (counter gives fresh thick nectar; Take is offered); Frezone instruction "attach detonator to explosive and timer" (maybe timer is a thing I cannot fetch: use my stopped chronometer repaired?), Floyd/Plato (Floyd's whereabouts unknown this timeline), ostrich nip (Doc's ceiling panel; need unknown way up), a coin #2 (none found).
2. Safe hole + Frezone (melts ~35 moves out of vacuum), Dome bin + fuel cells, quarnum wrench, Level 8 sealed, Comm radio mic, collater #22 / Printing, pyramid weapon (jammer 788?).
3. Spray can is 12 uses: plan the creature's route carefully (PX is 6 sprays from the Pet Store; Chapel 9).
### Numbers and procedures from the papers
- No new paper numbers this leg. Earlier: truck course 247 (QX-17-T slip 5400-5449), jammer frequency 788 (alien dots "78 7/8" via Mayor's taste dictionary) keeps the board green.
### What I would try next
- Take a cup of Fire Nectar to the PX and smear/hold it (grip), or try the plastic bag as a glove ("Wear"/"Put on"). Try the Large Drill Bit route differently (2 coins?). Read footnotes 2,3,5,8,9,13 again. Save slots now: 14 none new; 15 PX (stuck item 9), 16 Chapel (flame off, creature present, can nearly empty), 17 overwritten? Detonator takes ANY hyperdiode: with J removed, "put M-series in detonator" = "Done." (examine: contains an M-series hyperdiode); with J inside: "There's a J-series hyperdiode in the way." Welder Number 2 roams PX/North Junction/Level Five (day 3 too) when I carry no charged gun.
FINAL STATE: Chapel, hanging from the leash (let go = Down), flame OFF, score 45, detonator holds M-series diode, J-series diode in hand, spray can ~1 spray left, empty zapgun. Saves: 15 PX (item 9 stuck, day 3 move 743), 16 Chapel old (before diode), 17 = Warehouse day 3 (move 728; still valid: coin in hand, suit+boots at Warehouse).
END OF LEG 4 (cap ~1485/1500): final at PX, score 45, alive. Extra tests: Printing Plant equipment (no put-in), Aux Barracks desk/wardrobe filler, Gym has no machine, J-series diode up PX hole = drops out. Friction rows 9 (nice) and 10 (blocked, PX timer) filed. Not won.

friction.result: You drill a hole in the storage bin approximately the diameter of a pencil. (The game can no longer be won: the drill is spent. RESTORE...)
friction.why: Good: the game itself warned that the state was unwinnable and told me to restore; the first drill gave a warning with a clear 'one hole left' so I knew the risk. A save before it saved me.

friction.command: take magnetic boots (ID card on me)
friction.result: As you reach for the boots, your ID card twitches toward their magnetic soles... There will be no second warning
friction.why: Fair one-time warning before an irreversible loss of the modified ID card; very good design

friction.result: The coffee is poisoned! You have died.
friction.why: Fair trap given sabotage clues and the cold unattended cup, but I had no examine text hinting poison; examine only says cold coffee. Mild: death with no warning when thirsty

friction.result: elevator plunges in a power dive; You have died
friction.why: Elevator worked on day 2 but is sabotaged on day 3; no warning at all beforehand, I only had my own save to recover. Fair as sabotage escalation but harsh with no hint

friction.why: Rank-9 ID silently ruined by picking up boots; an earlier stocktake claimed a warning existed but none appeared; costs the Security-door access with no hint

friction.why: Clear that the item is stuck but no hint what tool frees it; ~40 commands of trial; every put-in item just 'drops out'. A nudge (e.g. examine hole says something about reaching up) would help

friction.command: open outer door in airlock without boots / carry explosive out of vacuum
friction.result: Lost in Space death; explosive melts ~40 moves after taking even in Thermos, harness warns unwinnable only after it sublimes
friction.why: Good: stencil + 'vac yard' text make magnetic boots the clear fix, and the 'getting softer' messages give fair warning. Bad: no UI countdown and the melt makes a restore far back

Compass lists 'E (elevator shaft)' with no hint it is deadly when elevator is absent; easy to mistake for the elevator door. Mild, since original canon does the same, but the click menu offers it as a plain exit

friction.command: spray can in each room; take leash in gravity; turn off chapel flame
friction.result: creature follows one room behind, lifts me 2 m, chapel star opens, +7
friction.why: A well-clued multi-step puzzle: sign says buoyancy useless in zero-gee, game hints 'somewhere with gravity', 'hastily puffs away' message points at the flame. Very satisfying

friction.command: reach in PX hole after buying timer/drill bit (also hanging 2 m from balloon leash)
friction.result: feel something with fingertips, can't get a grip
friction.why: After ~100 commands over 3 legs there is still no nudge to what frees the stuck item; many plausible tools (boots, dice, creature height, detonator) all fail silently
